actions.action: docker compose exec -T node pnpm exec commitlint --edit /app/.git/COMMIT_EDITMSG
actions.description: Validate commit message format against Conventional Commits standard

actions.action: docker compose exec -T node pnpm exec lint-staged --no-stash
actions.description: Run lint-staged for Node.js files (TS/JS, JSON, MD)

actions.action: git diff --name-only --cached --diff-filter=d | grep '.php$' | grep -v '^docker/' | xargs -r -I {} docker compose exec -T php php -l /var/www/html/{}
actions.description: Check PHP syntax on staged files

actions.action: git diff --name-only --cached --diff-filter=d | grep '.php$' | grep -v '^docker/' | xargs -r sh -c 'docker compose exec -T php vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --diff --dry-run --config=.php-cs-fixer.dist.php $(echo "$@" | sed "s|[^ ]*|/var/www/html/&|g")' _
actions.description: Check PHP coding style on staged files

actions.action: docker compose exec -T php vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --configuration=phpstan.neon --memory-limit=1G
actions.description: Run PHPStan static analysis (Level 5) before pushing to remote

actions.action: docker compose exec -T node pnpm test
actions.description: Run Vitest tests (Node.js unit & integration tests)
